limitations: Monthly cadence throughout; BLS unemployment is seasonally adjusted, Zillow indexes are smoothed + seasonally adjusted (ZHVI) / smoothed (ZORI).
Zillow monthly values are subject to revision; final value settles ~1 year after first print.
National macro predictors (BLS AHE/LFPR/emp-pop/JOLTS monthly; FRED mortgage & 10yr resampled to monthly means) added for the causal screen; rate-series log-returns are pp-change proxies.

EIA_HI_ELEC_* are Hawaii monthly retail electricity prices (cents/kWh, nominal). Genuine monthly Hawaii-specific price series — added as the monthly price proxy the causal screen needed (the genuine Urban Hawaii CPI is bimonthly). Published with roughly a 3-month lag and revised.

sources.EIA: https://api.eia.gov/v2/electricity/retail-sales — state monthly retail electricity price (cents/kWh), Hawaii
